scope: One World Trade Center, New York (simple schematic)
title: One World Trade Center
blurb: Simplified massing of the 1,776 ft tower by David Childs of SOM: four glass triangles and four chamfered corners rising from the fortified podium to the crown square rotated 45 degrees, with the 408 ft spire and its beacon.

sourceUrls.label: Architectural Record: One World Trade Center (2015)

systems.name: Base and podium
systems.description: The 185 ft fortified concrete podium with its glass fin cladding, main entrance and lobby.

systems.name: Tower facets
systems.description: The four tapering glass faces of the tower, each a single tall triangle in this simplified model.

systems.name: Chamfered corners
systems.description: The four chamfered corners with slotted steel screens, growing from the square base to the rotated crown.

systems.name: Crown and observatory
systems.description: The observatory levels and the glass crown parapet at 1,368 ft.

systems.name: Concrete core
systems.description: The reinforced concrete core running the height of the tower.

systems.name: Spire and ring
systems.description: The 408 ft spire on its broadcast ring, with the beacon at the symbolic 1,776 ft.

systems.name: Mechanical levels
systems.description: Plant floors, the sky lobby, and rooftop equipment.

systems.name: Site context
systems.description: Plaza, memorial pools, surrounding streets and the security line.

explanations.podium block: Simplified massing of the 200 ft square, 185 ft tall windowless concrete podium, the tower’s fortified base. Dimensions are rounded for this simplified model.
explanations.glass fin screen: Simplified glass fin cladding over the podium, lit at night in the real building. Fin spacing is schematic.
explanations.main lobby entrance: Simplified monumental entrance on the Fulton Street side. Exact portal design is schematic.
explanations.lobby hall: Simplified volume of the 55 ft high main lobby. Interior fit out is schematic.
explanations.south glass triangle: Simplified south face of the tower: one tall glass triangle tapering from the square base toward the rotated crown. Real panels are 13.33 ft tall floor to floor units.
explanations.west glass triangle: Simplified west face of the tower: one tall glass triangle tapering from the square base toward the rotated crown. Real panels are 13.33 ft tall floor to floor units.
explanations.north glass triangle: Simplified north face of the tower: one tall glass triangle tapering from the square base toward the rotated crown. Real panels are 13.33 ft tall floor to floor units.
explanations.east glass triangle: Simplified east face of the tower: one tall glass triangle tapering from the square base toward the rotated crown. Real panels are 13.33 ft tall floor to floor units.
explanations.southeast chamfer triangle: Simplified southeast chamfer: one tall triangle growing from the square base to the rotated crown square. Exact chamfer profile is schematic.
explanations.southwest chamfer triangle: Simplified southwest chamfer: one tall triangle growing from the square base to the rotated crown square. Exact chamfer profile is schematic.
explanations.northwest chamfer triangle: Simplified northwest chamfer: one tall triangle growing from the square base to the rotated crown square. Exact chamfer profile is schematic.
explanations.northeast chamfer triangle: Simplified northeast chamfer: one tall triangle growing from the square base to the rotated crown square. Exact chamfer profile is schematic.
explanations.chamfer slot screens: Simplified slotted stainless steel screens on the four chamfers, the signature treatment of the tower’s corners. Exact slot pattern is schematic.
explanations.observatory band: Simplified observatory levels, floors 100 to 102 at about 1,268 ft, with full height viewing glass. Interior fit out is schematic.
explanations.upper deck band: Simplified upper mechanical band below the crown. Exact louver pattern is schematic.
explanations.glass crown parapet: Simplified glass parapet at 1,368 ft, the same height as the original North Tower roof, its plan a square rotated 45 degrees from the base.
explanations.roof slab: Simplified roof slab behind the parapet. Exact layout is schematic.
explanations.core tube: Simplified 110 ft square reinforced concrete core running the height of the tower. Taper is schematic.
explanations.core base walls: Simplified thickened concrete walls at the core’s base. Exact thickness is schematic.
explanations.broadcast ring: Simplified circular support ring at the spire’s base, carrying broadcasting equipment.
explanations.spire mast: Simplified 408 ft sculpted spire, an 800 ton steel mast in the real building. Exact taper is schematic.
explanations.beacon tip: Simplified beacon light at 1,776 ft, echoing the torch of the Statue of Liberty.
explanations.cable stays: Simplified cable stays securing the mast to the crown. Exact cable layout is schematic.
explanations.lower plant floors: Simplified plant floors stacked inside the podium. Exact equipment is schematic.
explanations.upper plant band: Simplified upper mechanical levels below the observatory. Exact layout is schematic.
explanations.rooftop plant: Simplified rooftop equipment behind the parapet. Exact equipment is schematic.
explanations.sky lobby volume: Simplified double height sky lobby serving the upper floors. Interior layout is schematic.
explanations.plaza ground: Simplified plaza slab of the World Trade Center site. Extent is schematic.
explanations.memorial pools: Simplified pair of 9/11 Memorial reflecting pools just south of the tower.
explanations.street grid: Simplified surrounding streets: West Street, Vesey Street and Fulton Street. Widths are schematic.
explanations.bollard line: Simplified security line around the site. Exact positions are schematic.
